hardAcceptanceRules: corpusDigest must match the frozen corpus.json sha256
an observation must never fabricate acceptance without current-target evidence
a null metric value requires availability unavailable (or partial) and a non-empty missingReason
a ratio metric must carry explicit numerator, denominator, and excludedIncompleteCount
a nonzero denominator is required for measured_cost_per_accepted_result
an accepted result requires dataOrigin 'real' and actualResult 'pass' with all checks passed
limitations: offline scope: no live model execution, measured spend, or token capture; measured_cost_per_accepted_result is always null
target-orchestrator cases are historical observations whose primary evidence is in gitignored handoffs (.agents/teamwork/); provenance is textual, no frozen digest for that evidence
historical observations carry no token/timing identity; those metrics are null with reasons
first_pass_accepted_checkpoints, repair_cycles, review_cycles, and owner_escalations are unavailable in this offline scope

summary.acceptedResults counts real pass observations (case-oracle satisfied); the strict 'accepted results with matching current-target review receipts' metric requires live comparison-phase data and is not computable in this offline historical scope
snapshotCompleteness: complete: all seven case families represented with a validated observed result or clearly declared historical observation

metricAvailabilityCoverage.reason: no first-attempt review outcome in historical observations
evaluator counts actualResult pass with dataOrigin real
historical evidence records rounds, not assignment/candidate IDs
historical evidence records rounds, not distinct review sequences
no owner decisions in the frozen evidence
no wall-clock intervals in historical evidence
no token measurements in the offline scope

verificationEvidence: critic (verifier) review of the integrated 7-case candidate: single blocker (stale corpusDigest) fixed by the lead and re-verified (evaluator exit 0, valid:true, assessed:true, 32/32 tests pass)
auditEvidence: auditor integrity + semantics audit of the integrated candidate: PASS (captured baseline)
